title: researched reads a goal's lead-in sentence into question 1 and cuts a question at a semicolon inside it
goal: goal_questions drops a sentence that leads in a numbered piece (up to the first numbered piece, whatever its ending), so question 1 holds the piece's own words and not the lead-in's (kb-research, a topic slug), which researched's pack read as key words that made a good article weak, and a semicolon followed by a space inside a numbered question that ends in a question mark stays in that question, so its tail is not read as a question of its own that no article holds as a whole (ST-v7rqvnwe, ST-vyb5q5gp, ST-n5gxcl3n)

gates.question: Which text counts as a lead-in dropped before the first numbered piece, and when does a semicolon stay inside a numbered question?
options: Drop only text ending in a full stop or exclamation mark, and join a numbered piece to the text after a semicolon only when that text starts no numbered piece and ends in a question mark
Drop any text before the first numbered piece, a colon lead-in too, and join across every semicolon
gates.recommendation: Drop only text ending in a full stop or exclamation mark, and join a numbered piece to the text after a semicolon only when that text starts no numbered piece and ends in a question mark
gates.answer: Drop only text ending in a full stop or exclamation mark, and join a numbered piece to the text after a semicolon only when that text starts no numbered piece and ends in a question mark

notes: ST-vyb5q5gp (2026-10-18): its goal's first piece 'Answer with the kb tools first ... article. (1) When does SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE ...?' was read whole by researched, lead-in included; the pack went weak although python/stdlib-sqlite3-csv answers it, because the lead-in's hyphenated names stdlib-sqlite3-csv and shared-state counted as key words (the first, with a digit, as a named word that had to sit in a tagged fact). The worker had to put both names into the article's facts for researched to pass. ST-n5gxcl3n (2026-10-18): same defect. Its goal's lead-in 'Answer with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, ..., extending claude/otel-monitoring and logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline or a new OpenTelemetry Python SDK article.' ends in a period, so researched read question 1 whole: pack weak (18 of 29 key words), kb lacks: live, docs, gaps, written, gap, entries, kb-research, extending, new, article, provide; the same article gave good for the other seven questions. Planned into SP-cb5bp3sz on 2026-11-10; the draft's touches, checks and clause mapping were completed then.
